test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state passed a bill for the protection of advocates and became the first state to do so?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** became the first state in India to pass a bill for the protection of advocates.
 
• The bill aims to provide a safe environment for advocates to perform their duties without fear of violence or retaliation.
 
• It includes provisions for the protection of advocates against assault, grievous hurt, criminal force, and intimidation.
 
• The bill is a significant step towards ensuring the safety and security of legal professionals in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The bill was passed in response to increasing incidents of violence against advocates.
 
• Advocates play a crucial role in the justice delivery system, and their protection is essential for upholding the rule of law.
 
• Other states are also considering similar legislation to protect their legal professionals.
 
• The implementation of this bill is expected to create a safer working environment for advocates and encourage more people to join the legal profession.
 
• This move by Rajasthan sets a precedent for other states to follow in ensuring the safety of advocates.
